claims.summary: The astrid:llm module is a stateful scanner distinguishing raw marker bytes from functional role: referenced-as-string vs acting-as-command.
claims.disposition: verified_existing. Complete source at 902a0358: KnownModelControlMarkerMatch (L19-22) pairs an occurrence with an Option<reference_syntax>; scan_known_model_control_markers (L114-144) rebuilds a remainder, pushing the token back only when reference_syntax.is_some() (L129-131), i.e. a referenced marker is preserved and an acting/unreferenced marker is stripped. Her distinction is exact.

claims.summary: exact_reference_delimiter_syntax (L199) and followed_by_explicit_exact_token_relation (L64) determine whether a marker is a literal or a directive.
claims.disposition: verified_existing. L199 defines exact_reference_delimiter_syntax; L64 defines followed_by_explicit_exact_token_relation; reference_syntax (L49-60) calls delimiter syntax first, then the relation check. Citations are byte-exact against complete source.

claims.summary: scan_known_model_control_markers (L114) reconstructs a clean dialogue string while preserving identified-marker metadata in a KnownModelControlMarkerMatch vector.
claims.disposition: verified_existing. L114-144 builds (String remainder, Vec<KnownModelControlMarkerMatch> matches); each match carries occurrence + reference_syntax metadata. Exact.

claims.summary: MAX_EXACT_REFERENCE_DELIMITER_DEPTH (L151) and CONTROL_MARKER_CONTEXT_WINDOW_CHARS (L257) bound the look-ahead/look-behind scope.
claims.disposition: verified_existing. L151 = 4, applied via .take(MAX_EXACT_REFERENCE_DELIMITER_DEPTH) on before/after char scans (L208, L213). L257 = 64, applied in trailing_bounded_chars/leading_bounded_chars (L272-286). Both bounds are exact.

claims.summary: Snag: char-by-char delimiter inspection may return None for a multibyte-UTF-8-adjacent or uncovered delimiter, causing the marker to be treated as a raw command not a quoted string.
claims.disposition: verified_existing with correction. Consequence is real: unrecognized delimiter -> reference_syntax None -> not preserved -> stripped (the intended fail-closed cleanup, not a bug). But the mechanism is imprecise: the scan uses .chars() (Unicode-scalar-aware, L206-214), so multibyte UTF-8 never splits; many listed delimiters ARE multibyte and are preserved. Grounded by control_marker_scanner_advances_byte_exactly_across_multibyte_text, ..._abuts_four_byte_astral_chars, ..._preserves_non_ascii_matching_quote_pairs, cjk_corner_quoted_and_lenticular_grouped, ..._does_not_preserve_unclosed_or_mismatched_delimiters.

claims.summary: Snag: longest_exact_known_model_control_marker_at (L97) max_by_key(len) might prioritize a longer string that is a fragment of a different command if not validated against the full vocabulary.
claims.disposition: verified_existing; contradiction preserved. Source contradicts the mechanism: candidates are filtered to tokens in KNOWN_MODEL_CONTROL_MARKERS that the tail starts_with (L102-106), so every candidate is a COMPLETE vocabulary token, never an unvalidated fragment. known_model_control_markers_have_no_proper_prefix_shadow (tests L3309) proves no marker is a proper prefix of another, so the prefix-shadow overlap she anticipates is unreachable. That regression was authored to answer the identical greedy-shadow snag in prior report introspection_astrid_llm_1787782248. Concern preserved: the invariant test fails loudly if a future prefix-overlapping marker is added.

claims.summary: Test proposal: verify a quoted marker resolves to QuotedExactKnownToken and a marker followed by a relation verb resolves to ExplicitExactKnownTokenRelation.
claims.disposition: verified_existing. The distinction is covered: control_marker_cleanup_preserves_quoted_exact_token_reference (quoted->Quoted), scan_known_model_control_markers_preserves_grouped_and_explicit_relation_contexts (relation->ExplicitRelation), and ..._quoted_context_precedes_following_relation_verb (both present -> quoted precedence, matching source L50-53). Note: her example STOP is not in KNOWN_MODEL_CONTROL_MARKERS (real markers e.g. <end_of_turn>, [INST]); the existing tests use real markers, so no gap remains.

claims.summary: Test proposal: a nested structure exceeding MAX_EXACT_REFERENCE_DELIMITER_DEPTH should make the parser fail to identify the inner-most marker as a reference, preventing hallucinated context.
claims.disposition: verified_existing; contradiction preserved. Actual behavior differs from the predicted failure: context is set from the innermost adjacent delimiter regardless of depth; only the reported delimiter_depth saturates at 4 via .take(MAX). control_marker_cleanup_bounds_homogeneous_square_bracket_stack_beyond_max_depth (tests L2301, [[[[[<end_of_turn>]]]]]) and ..._bounds_deeper_delimiter_receipt_without_dropping_token (L2288) show the token stays byte-exact and preserved, context still grouped, depth bounded to 4 — it does not fail to classify. L2301 was authored to answer the identical proposal in prior report introspection_astrid_llm_1787026288.
